item.title: Killing Cache-Line Contention with Sharded Counters
item.author: rahul.kushwaha@gmail.com (Rahul Kushwaha)
item.description: A single hot AtomicU64 forces every writer to bounce the same cache line between cores. Sharding the counter across cache-line-padded atomics turns a contended fetch_add into uncontended local writes, at the cost of an O(SHARDS) read.
